parents.role: clarified: heuristics are forbidden as proof authority, not as discovery input
truth, reproducibility, exact scope, and skeptical-review constitution

canonical_law.formula: HEURISTIC_OR_ANALOGY_OR_OBSERVATION -> CANDIDATE_MECHANISM -> FORMAL_MATHEMATICAL_RESTATEMENT -> FROZEN_CLAIM -> PROOF_OR_EXHAUSTIVE_CERTIFICATE -> INDEPENDENT_REPLAY -> COMPLEXITY_PROOF -> SCOPED_SCIENTIFIC_PROMOTION
canonical_law.discovery_freedom: The discovery layer may intentionally use physical systems, music, stories, visual patterns, analogies, engineering mechanisms, intuition, and heuristic observations solely to generate candidate mathematical objects.
canonical_law.hard_firewall: After formalization, the heuristic origin has zero proof authority.

FORMALIZATION_LEDGER.purpose: convert candidates into metaphor-independent mathematical objects
FORMALIZATION_LEDGER.entry_condition: All metaphor-dependent language must be removable without changing the mathematical object.

allowed: exhaustive finite certificates with proved domain coverage

reviewer_test.question: Can a skeptical external researcher delete every reference to the discovery metaphor/source and still reconstruct and verify the complete mathematical claim from definitions, lemmas, certificates, source data, verifier, and complexity argument?
reviewer_test.failure_rule: If NO, the result is not ready for the PROOF_LEDGER.

interpretation_of_previous_strict_contra.clarification: The earlier phrase HEURISTICS_IN_SCIENTIFIC_PATH=FORBIDDEN applies to proof and scientific promotion authority. It does not prohibit heuristic or cross-domain idea generation in the DISCOVERY_LEDGER.

scientific_scope.rule: The origin of a candidate cannot increase or decrease the validity of a theorem; only the mathematics can.

semantic_seal.en: Explore widely. Formalize completely. Prove strictly. Claim only the exact proved scope.
semantic_seal.ru: Искать идеи можно где угодно. В математику входит только полностью формализованный объект. В доказательство входит только доказанная математика. Научный статус меняется только через Proof Ledger.
